profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | Project Manager | Freelancer
profile.summary:

💰Went from 5 to 6 figures under 12 months through Web and app development

positions.title: Sales Director
positions.description:
• Built a world-class team of Direct, Developers, Enterprise, Inside and Channel Sales Representative that spanned North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East to drive exponential growth.
• Maintained responsibility for all go-to-market strategies, recruiting, training, compensation plans, forecasting, marketing/sales initiatives, lead generation, negotiation, and customer retention.

positions.title: Business Development Manager
positions.description:
Managing a worldwide projects to drive business. Over the past years, KodeX has experienced a leading growth in customers.

With the addition of Customer Success to my organization I intend to establish a best practice Customer Success Management organization to achieve high rates of customer value realization, retention, and expansion.

Responsible for all Business Development and Partner Relationships and activities.
